summary: TASK 2 Incidents migration DOM verification. Queue page, table structure, empty-state contract, real-fragment search, state tabs, time-window, mine-toggle, legacy redirect (/xdr/incidents/_table -> /xdr/incidents), rebuilt domain pages (identity, endpoints incl. trajectory btn), detail route, analyst tenant scoping and smoke routes ALL pass. CRITICAL: clicking any incident row crashes the contextual pane (IncidentContextPane -> NxInvTable -> NxInvValue: `JSON.stringify(value)` on a React element with circular Fiber refs). NxErrorBoundary catches it so the flyout DOM (`incident-flyout`, `incident-flyout-body`, all `flyout-*` sections, `incident-flyout-open-investigation`, `incident-pivot-*`) never mounts. This single defect blocks the entire analyst pane / pivot workflow described in features 5, 6, 7, 8 and the dark-theme pane portion of feature 9.

ui_bugs.issue: `typeof value === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(value) : String(value)` — when a caller passes a React element (JSX) as `value`, JSON.stringify throws 'Converting circular structure to JSON' on the Fiber/HTMLDivElement backref. Reproduces every time an incident row is clicked on /xdr/incidents. NxErrorBoundary swallows the render so the flyout never appears (verified: after row click flyout=None, flyout_body=None, pageerror repeats 8x). Reproduced in light theme; same code path breaks dark theme flyout too. Caller is IncidentContextPane.jsx (verdict/facts NxKeyFact chain forwards a node to NxInvValue).

Clicking [data-testid="xdr-theme-toggle"] did NOT flip the document root theme attribute in this session (documentElement.dataset.theme and className both empty before AND after click; screenshot label still shows 'LIGHT'). Could not verify dark-theme rendering of table headers / rows / flyout / state chips. Needs a second look — either the toggle no-ops in this build, or the theme flag is stored on a different node (e.g., <body> or a context ref). Because the flyout also crashes, dark-theme pane contrast is unverifiable in this iteration.

integration_issues.flow: Row click -> contextual pane -> pivot / open investigation
integration_issues.issue: Blocked by the NxInvValue crash above. Because the pane is caught by NxErrorBoundary before mount, none of `incident-flyout-open-investigation`, `incident-pivot-timeline`, `incident-pivot-entities`, `incident-pivot-detections` are reachable, so the 'incident identity preserved through pivot' feature is unverifiable in the UI. (Domain routes /xdr/incidents/<id>/domain/identity|endpoints DO render correctly when navigated directly.)

State tabs update URL (?state=new) without error; 6 tabs enumerated
incidents-time-window select and incidents-mine-toggle present and clickable without runtime error
Legacy /xdr/incidents/_table redirects to /xdr/incidents and lands on the nx page (xdr-incidents-page present, no duplicate queue)

Domain pages render correctly for a real id (inc_8ddc1dee7a4c46aa93c9): identity has xdr-incident-domain-page + xdr-incident-domain-context + xdr-incident-domain-body-identity; endpoints has same plus xdr-domain-endpoints-open-trajectory
Detail route /xdr/incidents/<id> loads (no error overlay, body content > 100 chars)

Analyst tenant scoping honest: header shows 'customer nivx-live', row set is scoped (All open=1, New=1 per tab counts), admin tenant's incidents NOT visible; bulk buttons not rendered for this role (acceptable — no silent-success path)
Smoke routes mount for admin: /xdr/control-center, /xdr/detections, /xdr/investigations, /xdr/hunting, /xdr/events, /xdr/data-sources (shell text present, no React error overlay)
Flyout body overflow probe returned no horizontal overflow when the pane fell through to the error boundary (moot until pane is fixed)
action_items: FIX NxInv.jsx `NxInvValue`: never JSON.stringify an object without first rejecting React elements. Minimal patch: `if (React.isValidElement(value)) return {value}; if (typeof value === 'object') return {String(value?.label ?? value?.name ?? 'value')};` — or safer, require callers to pass primitives and coerce to `String()` unconditionally. The current path throws for any element/DOM/fiber-holding value.
Audit IncidentContextPane callers (NxKeyFact 'Derivation', 'Confidence', evidence NxMetric/NxRowFact etc.) to ensure they pass strings/numbers, not JSX fragments, into value=...

Re-verify /xdr/incidents row-click -> flyout mount, all `flyout-*` sections, `incident-flyout-open-investigation`, `incident-pivot-*` id preservation, truthful absence phrases, and dark-theme pane after fix.

Investigate why [data-testid="xdr-theme-toggle"] click did not toggle a persisted theme attribute (state may live on <body>, in localStorage, or in a React context not reflected on documentElement). Confirm both themes actually swap CSS variables when clicked.
critical_code_review_comments: NxInvValue's JSON.stringify branch is a landmine: any value with a React/DOM cycle blows up the whole section. Guard with React.isValidElement first (or just never stringify — pass strings only).

NxErrorBoundary hides this crash silently in production: the incident pane simply never appears. Consider surfacing a visible 'Section unavailable' fallback DOM so testing agents and analysts can tell a section died vs. never rendered.

IncidentContextPane funnels many heterogeneous shapes (verdict summary, canonical_evidence_ids counts, provenance sentences) into NxKeyFact/NxRowFact `value=`. Add PropTypes or a small runtime typecheck to reject non-primitives early.

success_rate.frontend: ~62% (10/16 groups pass; flyout+pivot group blocked by 1 critical bug; theme-toggle group inconclusive)

context_for_next_testing_agent: After the NxInvValue fix, re-run: (a) row-click on /xdr/incidents opens [data-testid=incident-flyout] with all 8 flyout-* sections, (b) eyebrow shows the clicked incident's INC number, (c) [data-testid=incident-flyout-open-investigation] navigates to /xdr/incidents/<same id>, (d) pivots /timeline /entities /detections navigate to /xdr/incidents/<same id>?tab=<tab>, (e) truthful-absence phrases in mitre/detections/entities sections, (f) toggle [data-testid=xdr-theme-toggle] and confirm CSS actually switches (documentElement or body attr / class / data-theme) then repeat queue + pane checks. Domain pages already verified in light theme. Preview host: https://greeting-app-5782.preview.emergentagent.com. NO Cloudflare challenge encountered.
rca of the issue: REPRO: Log in as admin, GET /xdr/incidents, click the first row [data-testid^='incidents-table-row-']. STACK: TypeError: Converting circular structure to JSON — starting at object with constructor 'FiberNode', property 'stateNode' -> HTMLDivElement, property '__reactFiber$...' closes the circle. Thrown at JSON.stringify (NxInv.jsx:46:41 in the served bundle = line 37 in source `typeof value === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(value) : String(value)`). Path: XdrIncidentsPage -> NxFlyout -> IncidentContextPane -> NxSection (`flyout-verdict-section`) -> NxFacts -> NxKeyFact -> NxInvTable -> NxInvValue. Caught by NxErrorBoundary so no visible flyout DOM. MITIGATION: guard `NxInvValue` to reject React elements (React.isValidElement) and coerce all remaining objects via a safe stringifier (or restrict the API to primitives). Sanitize IncidentContextPane callers passing JSX into `value`.
